backend.stopped: The Quality Assurance backend is not running, nothing is being recorded.
backend.startFailed: The backend could not be started: {error}

job.distribution: Filament monitor reading, time per 2 % class (s)

layers.none: No layers recorded for this job.
layers.filamentHint: Commanded: extrusion the filament monitor saw commanded; measured: movement it measured (calibrated.totalDistance).

channels.pruned: The raw data of this job was removed by retention; layers, events and the summary remain.
channels.downsampled: More points than can be shown: every n-th point is drawn.

hint.heater_load_mean: Mean load of each nozzle heater at its setpoint, per setpoint and nozzle. A rising load at the same setpoint, material and nozzle points at a weakening heater or a starting blockage.
hint.fm_avg_percentage: The monitor's average of the whole job. A slow drift over jobs points at wear of drive gear, idler or bearing.
hint.filament_ratio: Filament measured by the monitor per filament commanded, over the whole job.
hint.mm_per_rev: What RRF calibrated the monitor's sensitivity to in each job.
hint.esteps_suggested: The correction the machine's flow-bias detector suggested.
hint.heat_up_s: Time from a new setpoint to reaching it, first time in each job.
hint.duration_s: Job duration as RRF reports it.
hint.events: Events of a job without start and end.

chamberModes.auto: Automatic (chamber heater, else sensor by name)

fields.filamentPercentWindowMinS: Monitor outside its window at least
fields.retentionJobs: Keep raw data of the newest jobs
fields.contextGlobals: Global variables stored with each job
fields.mfm: Record the machine's filament monitor evaluation (MFM globals)

replay.legend: Colour: commanded volumetric flow from the G-code; dots: measured extrusion rate (same scale); rings: events. Wheel zooms, drag pans, double click fits.
replay.curves: Temperature and heater load of the layer
replay.building: The daemon is still indexing the G-code file…
replay.fileGone: The job file is no longer on the printer, or it was changed after the job.
replay.noLayer: The G-code file has no such layer.
